messages:
sam: quick sync — we need a final decision on surge ticketing model for reserved pools before we lock Q3 roadmap.
leila: customers want predictable latency during spikes + transparent billing. prefer ticketed surge rather than open percentage.
chen: engineering: ticket model gives us discrete admission control. tickets map to either prewarm slots or priority weight.
deepa: ops: must include an emergency circuit-breaker and an automated rollback per-tenant. playbook needs exact thresholds.
nora_pm: product proposal: default model = 10 tickets/day per 1k RU commit, premium = 30, enterprise = custom. tickets consumed per 1k tokens.
cal_sales: sales wants invoice line-item for tickets and an option to buy ticket bundles. enterprise will want rollover / monthly carry.
leila: UX: show a small "tickets remaining" pill on pool page and a historical burn chart. also surface projected cost if tickets used.
chen: infra sketch: when tenant redeems a ticket we either spin up prewarm N slots (if chosen) or boost scheduler priority for 10m, KV-pin TTL extended. tickets have cooldown window.
deepa: circuit-breaker rules (draft): if per-tenant queue_p95 > 300ms for 60s OR p99 > 1s for 30s -> throttle low-priority tenants, evict surge slots, enable fallback routing. ops alert and CS ping.
nora_pm: launch checklist: telemetry (ticket burn, p50/90/99 latencies, prewarm_gpu_hours), pilots (3 tenants: one health, one ecom, one internal), billing integration, UI mocks, runbook.
cal_sales: pilot ask: ACME & BetaBank are willing to pilot premium tickets for 4 weeks. need contract templates and SLA language for prewarm-backed guarantees.
leila: quality gate: no >2% regression on eval prompts for pilot tenants during ticketed surge. include hallucination checks + latency tail.
chen: sim request: give me 60 days of QPS + token hist for top 25 tenants to Monte Carlo ticket burn. I'll post numbers by Thu.
deepa: ops will draft automated rollback steps and a small demo playbook. also want a per-tenant emergency disable button in Console.
sam: decisions this week: ticket default rate, prewarm vs priority behavior on redemption, ticket cooldown, concurrent ticket cap per tenant, pilot list. owners: leila = UI, chen = infra sim, deepa = runbook, nora = pilots & SLA text, sam = pricing matrix.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled for policy "ticketed_surge_v1" on staging 2024-08-14T22:00Z.
sam: thanks — reconvene Fri 9am PT. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
